(2) The scene cuts to a green frog character wearing a blue suit and a red bow tie. The frog has large, sad-looking eyes and a slightly open mouth, conveying a sense of weariness. The background remains a consistent, soft indoor environment, suggesting a two-way dialogue session. (3) The heron character returns, continuing its explanation with gentle head tilts. The animation is characterized by flat colors and clean lines, emphasizing character expressions over complex textures. The lighting remains bright and even across the frame, highlighting the characters' emotional states. (4) A panda character appears in a new scene, acting as a judge. Its large eyes are fixed forward with a mix of surprise and understanding as the scene holds steady before the video ends.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 你也在「審判自己」嗎？[Logo]: @維恩維. [Subtitle]: 蛤蟆. (2) [Subtitle]: 你的遊戲玩的真棒！ (3) [Subtitle]: 遊戲！什麼遊戲！？我哪有玩遊戲啊？ (4) [Subtitle]: 我認為你在玩遊戲，玩一個名叫PLOM的遊戲。 (5) [Subtitle]: PLOM全名叫Poor Little Old Me，意思是「可憐弱小的我」。 (6) [Subtitle]: 蛤蟆非常生氣。 (7) [Subtitle]: 我誠實的告訴你這麼糟心的事，你卻說我在玩遊戲？ (8) [Subtitle]: 那麼，我們換一種方式來思考。 (9) [Subtitle]: 我們把「父母自我狀態」想像成一個法官。 (10) [Subtitle]: 法官一直在控訴別人，給人定罪吧。 (11) [Subtitle]: 你覺得老獾的行為像嗎？ (12) [Subtitle]: 哦，絕對像，他那副樣子，搞得我像罪犯一樣。 (13) [Subtitle]: 所以你在審判誰，蛤蟆。 (14) [Subtitle]: 我不審判誰，我就不是那種人啊。 (15) [Subtitle]: 蛤蟆一開始反駁，但沈默了一下又開口。 (16) [Subtitle]: 你是說我在審判我自己？ (17) [Subtitle]: 我猜，我判定了自己有罪，然後譴責自己，是這樣嗎？ (18) [Subtitle]: 蛤蟆又說：天哪，原來我們會懲罰自己。

The speech rate is moderate, and the piano music continues steadily underneath the dialogue. (3) A sharp, percussive thud occurs as a sound effect, mimicking a gavel strike. (4) The frog's voice becomes significantly softer and exhibits a breathy quality as it moves toward emotional vulnerability. The intensity of the speech drops, emphasizing the character's internal reflection. The piano melody remains consistent and supportive. (5) The conversation reaches a quiet resolution. The piano music swells slightly in a warm harmonic progression before fading out gracefully into silence along with the final vocal phrase. The overall mix is well-balanced with high signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a psychological insight into self-criticism and internal judgment based on the book 'Counselling for Toads'. The video uses a dialogue between a counselor and a patient to illustrate how individuals often judge and punish themselves internally.
